worldcombat.skill.tarshot.summary: Hurls a glob of sticky tar in a direction: on a hit it coats them, lowering their Speed stage and gumming up their movement, and while coated their weakness to Fire is doubled - any Fire-type move deals about x2 damage. You can also aim at the ground, where the glob lands and spreads, leaving a decorative patch of tar only above air (non-allies who step in are coated too); water washes the tar off.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.use.0: Coat a target ahead of an ally's Fire move
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.use.1: Slow a fast target and push it back
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.use.2: Turn a patch of ground into a tar pit that sticks to anyone
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.0: A first coating drops %1$s Speed stage(s) (counted as stat stages, not restored when the tar washes off); while coated the target's movement speed is lowered by 35%%, and the tar stays for about %2$s - getting wet or rain washes it off.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.1: While coated, its weakness to Fire is doubled: any Fire-type move deals about x%1$s damage, and a Fire-type hit or an already burning body ignites the target for about 1.5 s.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.2: The tar flies along the cast direction at about %1$s blocks per tick, with a %2$s block hit radius and up to %3$s blocks of range; aimed at an enemy it flies at them, aimed at the ground it flies to the landing point and disperses on exhaustion; a wide splash covers about %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.3: The impact or landing point leaves tar of about %1$s blocks for about %2$s; it is a decorative layer only above air and replaces no load-bearing block; non-allies who step in are coated the same way (Speed drop, slower movement and the doubled Fire weakness).
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.option.on: Wide splash: non-allies around the impact are coated too and the patch is bigger, at reach -2 blocks, flight about x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +10 ticks - coating a whole group, but slower, shorter and costlier.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.option.off: Focused: only the target hit is coated (a small patch still forms at the impact), with longer reach, faster flight and a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, spends %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.growth.0: At level %1$s the coat lasts %2$s and the tar patch lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.preference.wid: On: non-allies around the impact are coated too and the tar patch is bigger, at reach -2 blocks, flight about x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +10 ticks - coating a whole group, but slower, shorter and costlier. Off (focused): only the target hit is coated (a small patch still forms at the impact), with longer reach, faster flight and a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
The companion only considers tar on a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher lets it open from farther.

On: a target already carrying tar is not coated again - the value is opening the Fire weakness, and a second coat adds nothing, so the companion hands the turn to an ally's Fire move; off: coat again to refresh the duration.
When on, the companion may leave its post to throw tar even under a hold order.
